jsonld_raw.name: (200 G) OUD ÉCLAT SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax, presented in a removable ceramic container, inside a jar with a lid.

Oud Èclat | Enveloping and sophisticated, an endless array of fresh petals weave through spicy, peppery, and enigmatic phases, opening its heart to a sea of intense and unusually creamy woods.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, pink pepper, walnuts, Damask rose.
Heart notes: jasmine, caramel, peony, lily of the valley.
Base notes: cedar wood, patchouli.
